## ✦ Summary of Changes

Describe what changes you are introducing and the rationale behind them.

## ✦ Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] UI / UX / Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance optimization

## ✦ Testing & Verification

- [ ] Run `npm run lint` with zero errors
- [ ] Run `npm run build` and ensure production bundle compiles cleanly
- [ ] Tested in browser at `http://localhost:3000` with test usernames (e.g. `rj`, `cher`)
- [ ] Verified responsive layout and touch targets on mobile viewport

## ✦ Checklist

- [ ] Adheres to the dark risograph color palette and zero-pill typographic styling
- [ ] Complies with WCAG AA accessibility standards (focus rings, contrast, keyboard navigation)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or broken dependencies added
